references_source_ck.name: references_source_ck
references_source_ck.value: "source_url" IS NOT NULL OR "source_asset_id" IS NOT NULL

social_accounts_identity_uq.name: social_accounts_identity_uq
social_accounts_identity_uq.where: archived_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

comments_point_ck.name: comments_point_ck
comments_point_ck.value: ("point_x" IS NULL OR ("point_x" >= 0 AND "point_x" <= 1)) AND ("point_y" IS NULL OR ("point_y" >= 0 AND "point_y" <= 1))

tasks_dates_ck.name: tasks_dates_ck
tasks_dates_ck.value: "start_at" IS NULL OR "due_at" IS NULL OR "start_at" <= "due_at"

time_entries_interval_ck.name: time_entries_interval_ck
time_entries_interval_ck.value: "started_at" IS NULL OR "ended_at" IS NULL OR "ended_at" > "started_at"

handover_items_open_task_uq.name: handover_items_open_task_uq
handover_items_open_task_uq.where: state = 'open' AND task_id IS NOT NULL

handover_items_open_operation_uq.name: handover_items_open_operation_uq
handover_items_open_operation_uq.where: state = 'open' AND operation_id IS NOT NULL

shifts_actual_ck.name: shifts_actual_ck
shifts_actual_ck.value: "actual_end" IS NULL OR "actual_start" IS NULL OR "actual_end" >= "actual_start"

metric_observations_period_ck.name: metric_observations_period_ck
metric_observations_period_ck.value: "kind" <> 'period' OR ("period_start" IS NOT NULL AND "period_end" IS NOT NULL AND "period_end" > "period_start")

financial_entries_comp_run_uq.name: financial_entries_comp_run_uq
financial_entries_comp_run_uq.where: compensation_run_id IS NOT NULL AND reverses_entry_id IS NULL

fel_transaction_uq.name: fel_transaction_uq
fel_transaction_uq.where: transaction_ref IS NOT NULL AND is_reversal = false

incidents_alert_open_uq.name: incidents_alert_open_uq
incidents_alert_open_uq.where: alert_key IS NOT NULL AND state <> 'resolved'
